items.quote: My phone took a dive in water and wouldn't turn on. The technician at Auto Wirx recovered all my important photos and brought it back to life!
items.name: Theresa Webb

items.quote: Fast battery replacement and honest diagnostics. They showed me the exact battery health before and after, and gave a 6-month warranty. Highly recommended!
items.name: Ronald Richards

items.quote: Brought my OnePlus with a damaged charging port and muffled speaker. Fixed both on the same afternoon at very reasonable prices. True professionals.
items.name: Marcus Chen

items.quote: Friendly technicians, genuine parts, and quick turnaround. It is rare to find a mobile repair service that is this transparent and trustworthy.
items.name: Sarah Jenkins

items.quote: Their doorstep pickup and repair delivery saved my day when I was busy with work. My phone was returned looking brand new. 10/10 experience!
items.name: David Miller
